name: FurniMesh MCP
description: Search and preview public furniture assets on demand for governed scene workflows.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect the local FurniMesh MCP server. Calls read public FurniMesh HTML on demand and never download the full catalog.
methods.label: Connect FurniMesh MCP
warnings: FurniMesh scene units are metadata until calibrated; do not treat them as physical dimensions without review.
Scene writes require the Pascal Scene Asset Bridge and an explicit approval policy.
